svg.aria-label: Bar chart, log scale, p50 on an Android 17 emulator. phone-use against plain adb and phone-harness 0.3.3. UI tree, 1,000-row list 98 times faster than adb (phone-harness 111 times); Screenshot 41 times faster than adb (phone-harness 49 times); UI tree, Settings 27 times faster than adb (phone-harness 30 times); Type 100 characters 19 times faster than adb (phone-harness 22 times); Tap, then what changed 4.6 times faster than adb (phone-harness not supported); Tap, 1.5 s apart 1.7 times faster than adb (phone-harness 5.2 times); Tap, back to back 1.1 times faster than adb (phone-harness 1.3 times).
